$comment: Models you can pick when generating a CV, cover letter, answers or role analysis. The default is the wrangler var AI_MODEL. `provider`: workers-ai (the AI binding), openai (any OpenAI-compatible API at baseUrl, key from the secret named in keyEnv) or claude. `strong` runs analysis and writing; `fast` runs cheap steps (claim checks, eligibility); a null `fast` uses WORKERS_AI_FAST_MODEL. Every option falls back to WORKERS_AI_STRONG_MODEL / WORKERS_AI_FAST_MODEL when its API fails. Options whose key isn't set are hidden. Timings measured 2026-09-28; see docs/models.md.

options.label: gpt-oss-120b
options.note: Fastest: about 3 minutes for a CV and cover letter. Free daily quota covers roughly 1–3 jobs a day.

options.label: GLM-5.3-Flash
options.note: Better writing, free, no daily cap. The free queue takes 1–5 minutes per step, so a CV and letter can take 20 minutes or more.

options.label: GLM-5.3
options.note: The strongest open model here, but it didn't respond on the free tier in testing. Falls back to gpt-oss-120b.

options.label: Claude Opus 5
options.note: Paid. Also researches the company with cited web sources.
